title: Odile and the Cipher
author: Orsen Pemberton
blurb: Elodie Kavanagh, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
